events.body: segment F3 has 3 findings: give exactly one

ruling.recommended_action: Refund $6.94 to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) for the unexcused portion of the 10:13–10:24 off-route segment; no account flag (RD-6 not triggered).
ruling.reasoning: This is a metered RydeTAXI trip, so the fare is not a fixed quote and deviation kilometres feed the meter directly [F7]; RD-2 therefore allows a partial refund of the distance units attributable to any unexempt off-route segment [RD-2]. One off-route segment exists in the record: 10:13–10:24, 7.21 km driven against 2.29 km of optimal route, +4.92 km [F3], matching the computed RD-1 check [RD-1].

segment_findings.reason: Before the segment began at 10:13 [F3], the driver proposed a route change and the rider replied “Sure, your call.” at 10:10 [F8][F9]. That reply is an unqualified general authorisation of the route change (“your call”), which under RD-5 covers the route chosen to get to the destination rather than a specific named road; it was given by the rider ahead of the segment and the chat record is complete and fully timestamped [F10].

The rider's authorisation covered a route chosen to get to Jurong East [F8][F9]; the driver's own account afterwards describes a breakdown “on the route” and the detour only as “another way” [F11], and the only breakdown in the record is on the Ayer Rajah Expressway, 0 m from the optimal route — i.e. on the very stretch being replaced — with no location placing the driven path on Clementi Avenue 2 [F15]. Nothing in the record ties the driven 7.21 km to the proposed route, and a deviation this large (up to 1794 m off the optimal route, +5.7 km total, +14.9 min) [F1][F2][F3] is not covered by an authorisation to choose the way; the excess distance attributable to it remains refundable under RD-2 [RD-2][RD-5].

The driver's “reasonable cause” claim does not qualify under RD-4(a): the RD-4(a) screen fails — the only incident (vehicle breakdown reported 09:47) sits 0 m from the optimal route on the Ayer Rajah Expressway stretch that was replaced, so nothing supports the substituted stretch [F15], and the Ayer Rajah Expressway speed-band 2 record alone cannot exempt a segment [F12][RD-4].
